findings.issue_category: public bucket access / no ACL restriction
findings.description: The 'data' bucket is explicitly commented as public and defines no ACL, no public access block, and no bucket policy restricting access. Any object stored in it — including the customer master spreadsheet — may be readable by anonymous internet users.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so sensitive customer data stored in this bucket is not guaranteed to be encrypted with a managed/KMS key.
No logging block is configured, so unauthorized access to this publicly exposed bucket would leave no audit trail for detection or forensics.
Versioning is disabled, so objects deleted or overwritten by an attacker (the bucket is public and force_destroy is true) cannot be recovered.

A customer master data file ('customer-master.xlsx') is uploaded into aws_s3_bucket.data, which is public and unencrypted, exposing PII/customer records to anonymous access. No kms_key_id is set on the object either.
The financials bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving financial records stored without enforced encryption at rest.
No logging block is configured for a bucket holding financial data, eliminating the audit trail required for detecting unauthorized access.
Versioning is not enabled, so accidental or malicious deletion or overwriting of financial objects is unrecoverable; force_destroy is also true.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined for the operations bucket, so stored data is not protected by enforced SSE-KMS encryption.
No logging block is configured, so S3 access to this bucket is not recorded for audit or incident response.
The data science bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration, so potentially sensitive analytical datasets are stored without enforced encryption at rest.

Like the other buckets in this file, the log bucket has no aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block association, so account- or bucket-level public ACLs/policies could still be applied to it; it also lacks a policy enforcing aws:SecureTransport for data in transit.
